votes.motion: Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to open the public hearing for File #OAM2022-000718
Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to close the public hearing
Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to adopt Ordinance No. 2022-O-09
Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to open the public hearing for File #OAM2022-000721
Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to close the public hearing

Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to adopt Ordinance No. 2022-O-10 and to direct planning staff to research the best way to simultaneously vacate the remaining alley’s within Magna Metro Township, and present its findings to the Council
Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve funding request of $500 to the Magna Chamber of Commerce

Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to defer the request for funding for the Magna Town Council until the 2023 Magna Metro Township budget is discussed at a future meeting

Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to delay any decisions regarding the intersection realignment until the Council can get more clarity on what the request and proposal is and what issues are driving the request

Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to recommend approval of the request, and direct the Redevelopment Agency Executive Director to negotiate an agreement between the Salt Lake County Redevelopment Agency and the developer, subject to final approval of the Salt Lake County Redevelopment Agency Board of Trustees on the condition that the amount is up to $5.9 million of increment, with no guarantee to meet that amount, and no guarantee of an extension. Magna Metro Township and the Salt Lake County Redevelopment Agency will be held harmless
